name: Murmuration
description: A flock of several hundred birds that moves as one body, stretching, folding and turning across the frame.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of birds in a 960 by 480 frame. Smaller and larger frames scale it with their area, from 0.45 to 1.3 times.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the birds. Any CSS colour or variable; it is read again when the theme changes.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the whole flight: the birds, the turns and the slow sweep across the frame.

props.name: interactive
props.description: When true the pointer parts the flock like a falcon passing through, and a click startles it.

props.name: seed
props.description: Picks where the flock starts and how it is shaped. The same seed gives the same flight.

props.name: focus
props.description: Centre of the wide figure of eight the flock sweeps round, as fractions of the width and height. Move it away from your headline.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the flock. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the sky. Clicks on links, buttons and fields stay with them; clicks elsewhere startle the flock.
